title: Connect to Wi-Fi
aliases: how do i connect to wifi
connect my phone to the home internet

steps.instruction: Turn on "Wi-Fi" if it is off.
Tap the name of the network you want to join.
Type the Wi-Fi password, then tap "Join".

source_note: Settings on iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. For a new password-protected home network; the password is entered in Settings. Known or open networks may connect without the password step; public networks may show a separate sign-in page. A tick next to the network indicates connection. Confirm the password screen and Join label. Not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.apple.com/en-ie/111107
